text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ministerial committee verifies lists of detainees arrested during civil disturbances last August over rise in bread prices and covered by a royal pardon.
- Three billion dinars ($4.2 billion) are needed for investments in water and irrigation sector, researcher says.
- King Hussein urges Arab political parties to undertake a comprehensive review of their plans, tactics and methods.
- Crown Prince Hassan says Jordan spends 14 percent of its budget on education.
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu briefs King Hussein on his contacts with Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat.
- Royal Jordanian head says to embark on an adminstrative revolution to restructure the debt-ridden airline.
- Stock market higher with end-of-year closing of accounts.
